paragraphs: Year-end is the busiest period. First consolidate departmental requests and rank allocations by strategic priority. Each month during execution, compare actuals with budgets, investigate overspending, and recommend cost controls. Business leaders compete for allocations, so use data to explain approvals and denials. Turn the results into reports that support management's decisions for the next year.
